evidence_required: the rail mapping argument and its effect on a 256-GPU job.

marking.criterion: Rail mapping: orion-be-leaf-r<r> connects NIC r of every node, so a leaf loss removes one NIC from all 32 nodes
Job effect: every communicator using rail r breaks; the 256-GPU job fails and restarts (not just −1/8 bandwidth)
Contrast with a top-of-rack leaf, whose failure removes only its own rack's servers

title: Why one leaf is a cluster-wide fault domain
